entry.summary:
Kiwi pole vaulters Eliza McCartney and Imogen Ayris say challenging conditions made for a "weird competition" after winning medals in Glasgow | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1
 
Following years of injury setbacks, McCartney has claimed her first Commonwealth Games gold, while teammate Ayris secured bronze.

Full story: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/sport/855179/eliza-mccartney-finally-claims-elusive-commonwealth-crown
